props.name: activationMode
props.description: Whether keyboard activation happens immediately or only after confirmation.

props.name: class
props.description: Class applied to the component root or trigger element.

props.name: classes
props.description: Family slot class defaults for this instance.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Default active step value for uncontrolled usage.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the entire stepper is disabled.

props.name: id
props.description: Unique identifier for the stepper root element.

props.name: items
props.description: Array of steps to display.

props.name: loop
props.description: Whether keyboard navigation loops around when reaching the ends.

props.name: navigation
props.description:
How users move between steps. `none` keeps only the active step enabled, `linear` also allows
completed steps and the next step, and `free` allows every enabled step.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Callback when the active step changes.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Layout axis used by the component Recipe.

props.name: size
props.description: Visual size of the component.

props.name: style
props.description: Style applied to the component root or trigger element.

props.name: styles
props.description: Family slot style defaults for this instance.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled active step value.

item.description: An individual step in the stepper.

props.name: class
props.description: Additional class name for the step item.

props.name: content
props.description: Content to display when the step is active. Accepts static JSX or a component receiving { value, active, completed, index }.

props.name: description
props.description: Secondary description of the step.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the step is disabled.

props.name: icon
props.description: Icon to display in the step indicator.

props.name: title
props.description: Title of the step.

props.name: value
props.description: Unique value for the step.
